posts.title: The MegaWave Radio Surveyor
posts.description: The MegaWave Radio Surveyor would be a space interferometer addressing Decadal-level astrophysics, exoplanets, and cosmology using radio frequencies inaccessible from Earth.

posts.title: William G. Bagnuolo, Jr. (1948 – 2025)
posts.description: Bagnuolo was a pioneer in optical long-baseline interferometry who helped design and build the CHARA Array at Mount Wilson Observatory. He was also a mentor to graduate students in work related to innovative instrumentation and new techniques in studies of binary stars.

posts.title: Karen B. Kwitter (1951–2024)
posts.description: Karen leaves a legacy of important research on planetary nebulae and galactic chemical evolution, generations of students inspired to pursue astronomy, and substantial service to the astronomical community.
